energy_subsectors.name: Regulated Utilities
energy_subsectors.economics: CapEx → eligible rate base → earned return → earnings; funding and dilution determine per-share returns.
energy_subsectors.valuation: Regulatory DCF / rate-base economics; P/E cross-check

energy_subsectors.name: IPPs & Merchant Generation
energy_subsectors.economics: Net MW × hours × capacity factor × realized spread; separate contracted energy, merchant energy and capacity revenues.
energy_subsectors.valuation: Plant/contract DCF; normalized EV/EBITDA and FCF

energy_subsectors.name: Natural Gas Generation & Turbine Equipment
energy_subsectors.economics: Separate plant ownership from turbine manufacturing; orders → backlog → deliveries → service; cash depends on execution and working capital.
energy_subsectors.valuation: Equipment earnings/DCF versus generation cash flow

energy_subsectors.name: Nuclear Power & SMRs
energy_subsectors.economics: Separate operating nuclear, component suppliers and pre-revenue developers; availability and contract economics differ from licensing/financing options.
energy_subsectors.valuation: Operating DCF; supplier earnings; probability-weighted development NAV

energy_subsectors.name: Renewable Energy & Battery Storage
energy_subsectors.economics: Separate developers/asset owners from manufacturers; generation profile/PPA and storage duration/spreads drive economics.

energy_subsectors.name: Grid Infrastructure, Transmission & EPC
energy_subsectors.economics: Funded/executable backlog conversion × margin; labor, project execution and working capital determine cash conversion.
energy_subsectors.valuation: Earnings multiples and cycle-aware FCF DCF

energy_subsectors.name: Electrical Equipment, Transformers & Switchgear
energy_subsectors.economics: Shipments × price + service; backlog conversion, price/cost and capacity additions determine margin durability.

energy_subsectors.name: Behind-the-Meter, Distributed Generation & Microgrids
energy_subsectors.economics: Separate equipment sale/service from owned power-as-a-service; lifecycle fuel/capex, reliability and time-to-power matter.
energy_subsectors.valuation: Equipment comps or project cash-flow DCF
